subject.title: [AI-assisted] fix(cli): surface session lane busy exits

question: Should same-session CLI lane waits return a terminal busy result by default for every source-entrypoint CLI dispatch, including admin-authority CLI paths?
rationale: The implementation changes CLI delivery semantics and currently excludes supported admin-authority CLI variants, so maintainers need the intended compatibility boundary before merge.

options.title: Repair All Source-CLI Paths
options.body: Keep the server-side compatibility repair while preserving busy rejection for ordinary and admin-authority CLI dispatches, with non-CLI callers still unopted.

options.title: Accept Ordinary-CLI Only
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally limit the behavior to CLI identity connections, but model override and reset CLI calls would remain outside the fix.

options.title: Pause Busy-Result Contract
options.body: If terminal busy rejection is not the desired default CLI delivery contract, pause this PR until the product behavior is settled.

recommendation.title: Repair All Source-CLI Paths
recommendation.body: Keep the server-side compatibility repair while preserving busy rejection for ordinary and admin-authority CLI dispatches, with non-CLI callers still unopted.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Gateway-backed CLI route and adjacent queue diagnostics history make this the strongest routing signal for the compatibility choice.
